# T-1: Model bounded child execution evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Extend the existing child process result module and test runner boundary to produce one invariant-checked, bounded execution record for every nested category command without changing invocation behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 records every required lifecycle, termination, command, and stream field.
- R2 distinguishes all required typed outcomes and requires concrete assertion evidence.
- R3 enforces stream bounds and serializes truncation metadata.
- R4 emits one parseable marker per executed category with unchanged runner behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Extend ChildProcessExecutionResult with dedicated stream-capture and serialization classes rather than plain record literals. Keep executeFiles as the single spawn owner. Use a stable marker/parser contract shared with final-regression, exclude marker text from user stream payload parsing, and keep size/count limits explicit.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local unit coverage for constructors, invariants, UTF-8 byte bounds, exact-bound and over-bound captures, all termination modes, assertion evidence detection, marker round trips, every-category emission, summary/exit parity, and spawn-count spying. Update affected shared tests for the exported result contract.
